nodes.name: Normalize Fields
nodes.notes: This is the one Code node in the flow -- used for case/space-insensitive header matching across 3 different CSV formats, which isn't expressible as simple per-field Set-node expressions. The trigger, DB checks, branching, and both write-back actions are all native n8n nodes; this isn't a pure-code solution wearing an n8n costume.

parameters.query:
SELECT
  '{{ $json.candidate_name.replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS candidate_name,
  {{ $json.email_normalized ? `'${$json.email_normalized.replace(/'/g, "''")}'` : 'NULL' }} AS email_in,
  {{ $json.phone_normalized ? `'${$json.phone_normalized}'` : 'NULL' }} AS phone_in,
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM persons
    WHERE ({{ $json.email_normalized ? `email = '${$json.email_normalized.replace(/'/g, "''")}'` : 'FALSE' }})
       OR ({{ $json.phone_normalized ? `phone = '${$json.phone_normalized}'` : 'FALSE' }})
  ) AS is_duplicate,
  (SELECT id FROM persons
    WHERE ({{ $json.email_normalized ? `email = '${$json.email_normalized.replace(/'/g, "''")}'` : 'FALSE' }})
       OR ({{ $json.phone_normalized ? `phone = '${$json.phone_normalized}'` : 'FALSE' }})
    LIMIT 1) AS matched_person_id,
  (SELECT name FROM persons
    WHERE ({{ $json.email_normalized ? `email = '${$json.email_normalized.replace(/'/g, "''")}'` : 'FALSE' }})
       OR ({{ $json.phone_normalized ? `phone = '${$json.phone_normalized}'` : 'FALSE' }})
    LIMIT 1) AS matched_person_name;

nodes.name: Check Against Database
nodes.notes: NOTE ON SQL SAFETY: this demo builds the query via string interpolation with manual quote-escaping (replace(/'/g, "''")) rather than the Postgres node's native parameter binding, to keep the expression readable inside this JSON export. For anything beyond a take-home demo, switch to $1/$2 placeholders + the node's 'Query Parameters' field instead -- interpolated SQL is a real injection risk if this ever accepts untrusted input directly.

nodes.name: Send Duplicate Alert
nodes.notes: Swap the URL for a Slack Incoming Webhook URL or any endpoint you want. For the demo video, https://webhook.site gives you a free, instant URL you can watch the alert land on in real time -- no account needed.

nodes.name: Insert New Person
nodes.notes: Goes beyond the minimum spec: rather than only alerting on duplicates, genuinely new people get merged straight into the canonical persons table, extending Task 1's pipeline with a live intake path instead of only a batch one.
